title: Control case: without a configured resource, the query string does reach the facilitator
provenance: Modeled from @x402/express 2.30.0 index.mjs line 54 (getUrl returns protocol+host+req.originalUrl, which includes the query string).
limits: Shows the default is not broken by itself. Does not show every adapter behaves the same; only @x402/express was read for this vector.
note: Same two requests as the previous vector, minus the configured resource string: the facilitator now sees two different resource.url values, one per account.
